variants.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: PawTrail complete selectable MALE player animation atlas and matching dialogue portrait.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for exact animation layout and pixel-art style. Replace the existing female character in ALL 108 small poses AND the single portrait with ONE consistent original young adult MALE animal rescuer: A young man with tousled blonde hair, a denim jacket, cream T-shirt, charcoal shorts, brown hiking shoes, and a sage backpack. No glasses, no ponytail.
Design a friendly unmistakably male face, short hair and clean silhouette, keeping the game's same compact RPG proportions. Do not leave the woman's ponytail or face on any sprite. The portrait must show the exact same man, hair, skin, glasses if specified, and outfit as his sprites.
Preserve each pose/action, all four movement directions, props and animation order. Do not repeat one pose for every cell. Outfit and hair must stay identical across every frame, including up/back views, walking, sitting, sleeping, feeding, petting and carrying/placing props. Trousers stay trousers, shorts stay shorts. Backpack color stays consistent.
Keep image geometry and complete asset count: 1152x1584 canvas. Top y0..1296 is 12 columns by9 rows (108 sprites), each original sprite remains in its own original cell. No new or missing cells, no overlap, no cropping feet. Bottom area contains one chest-up portrait centered in the same position. Preserve generous transparent spacing around sprites.
Maintain cozy 16-bit top-down 3/4 pixel art, dark warm outlines, upper-left lighting, same native32x48 character scale and pixel density as reference. Real sharp square pixels, no smoothing, no blur, no gradients. A small cohesive palette; hair/outfit ramps include #fff1bf, #f2d17c, #d9ab52, #ab7936, #6d492b, #81acbe, #537e9c, #34566d, #273945.
Genuine transparent background with alpha. No scenery, labels, text, cell lines, decorative borders, UI, ground shadows or watermarks.
